title: Higher resolution
description: Draw the game at a larger size than the Switch's docked 1600x900. Costs GPU time and memory.

title: Pulled-back camera
description: Move the in-game camera further from the hero to see more of the area. 1.0 is the game's own distance; 1.5 is a good start. Far values show more fog and may show unloaded edges.

title: Faster heroes
description: Multiply how fast heroes walk, run and sprint. 1.0 is the game's own speed.

title: Seasons (offline)
description: Make a season active without Blizzard's servers, so the Season Journey and seasonal heroes are available. The game's data holds 12 sets of seasonal content that repeat (season 13 is the same as 1), so these are all the distinct choices. Leaderboards and other online parts of seasons stay unavailable. The season number picks the Season Journey only; for a season's theme, turn on Season theme below.

title: Season theme (offline)
description: Turn on one of 2.7.7's season themes. On the Switch these were switched on by Blizzard's servers for the length of a season, so offline none ever start. The theme applies to every hero, seasonal or not. With any theme on, the Altar of Rites (season 28) and Visions of Enmity portals (season 29) are on too, as in 2.7.7. Season 23's theme (followers that fight like heroes) is built into 2.7.7 and needs no switch; season 26's (Ethereal on demand) is the same as 24.
labels: Season 17: Legacy of Nightmares for everyone
Season 19: Pandemonium (angels and demons in rifts)
Season 20 and 31: Kanai's powers, one item of each kind free
Season 21: Trials of the Tempests (elemental bursts)
Season 22: Echoing Nightmares (shadow clones, 4th cube slot)
Season 25 and 30: the Lords of Hell's soul shards
Season 29: Visions of Enmity only (nesting portals)

title: Challenge Rifts (offline)
description: Play Challenge Rifts without Blizzard's servers. Each challenge was two files the game downloaded every week; offline nothing arrives, so the game reads them from the rift_data folder in your game folder instead (challengerift_config.dat and challengerift_00.dat, challengerift_01.dat and so on). This project ships no challenge files: they hold the hero and account of the player who set the record. With Rotate, the challenges in the folder take turns, moving on each time you earn a reward; a number always plays that file. Challenge Rifts open once a hero on the account has cleared a solo Greater Rift (the Cheats panel's Greater rifts to 70 does that). Leaderboards stay unavailable.

title: Cheats (for testing)
description: In the game, F1 raises your hero to level 70, F2 adds 100 paragon levels and F3 adds 10,000,000 gold. While the game runs, the Cheats panel below can also add gold, give you any item, unlock Kanai's Cube, count greater rifts up to a tier as cleared solo (which opens Challenge Rifts) and give Horadric Caches from any act (at the game's current difficulty). Changes are saved with your hero.

title: Mouse
description: Use a mouse or trackpad alongside the controller. In menus, point at an entry to select it and click to choose it; a dialog's Accept and Cancel can be clicked. In the game, hold the left button to walk toward the pointer and hold the right button to use your primary skill (A), which also talks, opens and picks up.

title: Deckard Cain's gems
description: Deckard Cain stands in New Tristram again, up and to the left of the waypoint, and sells custom legendary gems at their highest rank. Each adds a pylon's buff every so many kills while socketed. A hero holding one of these gems needs this mod on to load.

title: Corrupted legendaries
description: Kanai's Cube gains a Corrupt Legendary recipe: 1 legendary, 25 Death's Breath, 5 Forgotten Souls and 1 Corrupted Angel Flesh. The item gains a random boss skill (Diablo's Ring of Fire, Belial's lightning, Malthael's Mephisto skulls and more) that your hero sometimes casts on hit. Corrupting again rerolls the skill. A hero holding a corrupted item needs this mod on to load.
